after.zh: 一个亮点是离散冲激。它的输出是滤波器的冲激响应，可以用来找回权重。卷积把核按原方向铺在亮点周围；本关的元件做互相关，输出是绕亮点旋转 180° 的核。亮点测试让你读出这种方向差异，方块和字母再检验同一组权重。
after.en: A single bright pixel is a discrete impulse. Its output is the filter’s impulse response and lets you recover the weights. Convolution places the kernel around the impulse in its original orientation. This part performs cross-correlation, so its output is the kernel rotated 180° around the impulse. The dot reveals the orientation, and the square and letter test the same weights.

t.zh: <level-ref to="1-8"></level-ref>得到的<part-ref to="kernel3"></part-ref>：九个权重由你来填。默认只有正中间是 1，输出和输入一模一样。
t.en: The <part-ref to="kernel3"></part-ref> you earned in <level-ref to="1-8"></level-ref>: you fill in the nine weights. By default only the centre is 1, so the output is identical to the input.

t.zh: 修图软件的滤镜、相机里的锐化，背后常常就是一个核。这一关反过来：别人用一个核处理了几张图，你只看得到输入和输出，要把那个核找出来。
t.en: Behind photo-editor filters and in-camera sharpening there is often just a kernel. This level turns that around: someone has processed a few images with a kernel, and from only the inputs and outputs you must find that kernel.

t.zh: 这一关你要做的：把你的核拧成和它一样，让三组测试全部通过。
t.en: Your task in this level: dial your kernel in until it matches, so that all three tests pass.

brief.zh: 有人用一个 3×3 核处理了这些图。把你的核拧成和它一样。
brief.en: Someone processed these images with a 3×3 kernel. Dial your kernel in until it matches.

hint.zh: 亮点会变成核的样子。可你的元件是怎样读核的？把你填的核喂一个亮点，看看出来的是什么。
hint.en: A bright dot turns into the shape of the kernel. But how does your part read its kernel? Feed a bright dot to the kernel you entered and see what comes out.
